ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 4:1 ratio of low-intensity black pixels to high-intensity white pixels; white pixels are primarily localized to the distal tips and specific surface markings.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large high-intensity white blob at the distal tip of the left lobe extending approximately 20% along the trailing edge; smaller, fragmented high-intensity white patch at the distal tip of the right lobe; sparse focal white spots scattered within the central low-intensity black regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an internal angle of approximately 65 degrees and a bounding-box depth equivalent to roughly 20% of the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude variations of peaks and valleys range from 5 to 25 pixels; distinct jagged profile isolated from the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex upward trajectory on the outer edges, tapering to sharp points at the distal tips; trailing edge shows a complex, non-linear serrated curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two distinct circular high-contrast white clusters on the mid-left lobe; multiple smaller white circular focal points near the trailing edge of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several high-contrast white linear marks (rake marks); left lobe contains two prominent parallel diagonal lines and one shorter vertical line; right lobe displays multiple unaligned thin horizontal and diagonal scratches.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Brownish-orange textured biological clusters (epibiotic growth) attached to the furthest points of both distal tips, most prominent on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Fine white speckling pattern localized in the lower-central dark region of the left lobe near the fluke center.
